description: This file defines a class 'Generate' that extends 'DauxCommand' to implement a command-line utility for generating documentation in a PHP project. It configures command options, prepares configuration settings, and triggers documentation generation, interacting with the Daux static site generator framework.

classes.name: Generate
classes.description: A command class for generating documentation within the Daux static site generator framework. Extends DauxCommand and provides configuration, preparation, and execution of the generation process.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command's name, description, and options.

methods.name: prepareConfig
methods.description: Prepares and customizes the configuration builder based on input options.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the documentation generation process, initializing necessary components and triggering the generation steps.
